solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::integer AS shipments,
       COUNT(e.id)::integer AS events
FROM shipments AS s
LEFT JOIN shipment_events AS e ON e.shipment_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.customer_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id;

ambiguities.readingChosen: Only customers that have shipments (customers 1 to 6 here).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Every customer in the customers table, adding customers 7 and 8 with 0 shipments and 0 events.

notes: Events summed across customers total 678, equal to the shipment_events row count, so the join neither drops nor duplicates events.
